messages:
Ivy: hi all, ivy here (joining infra). Quick map request: where do I post machine/setup errors, noisy ci/build chatter, product ideas, and small UX nitpicks? Also, got several bot DMs on join  how do I tone them down but still get oncall pages?

Jae: welcome Ivy! short map: machine/setup -> #help (include OS + paste 1-2 lines of error), ci/build -> #build-failures (muteable), prod ideas -> #product-feedback, ux/visual -> #design. Squad-specific stuff belongs in the squad channel.

Ivy: thanks. example: I tried `rwi-setup` and got "permission denied" on docker socket. who should I ping?

Morgan: open a post in #help and tag @infra, paste the single error line and your hostname. If it's blocking, start the message with [BLOCKING]. DMs to infra are fine for quick unblock but tickets in #help help others later.

it-bot: Welcome Ivy! To finish onboarding run:

```
$ rwi-setup --install
$ rwi-auth link
```

Reply "done" when finished.

Ivy: ran it, saw `error: permission denied /var/run/docker.sock`. posted in #help.

Jae: perfect. about bot noise: go to Apps -> select the bot -> disable "Direct messages" or in channel click bell -> Mentions & keywords only. Keep @oncall in your notification keywords so pages get through.

ops-bot: New: you were added to rwi-ops. Repo: https://git.internal/rwi-ops

Ivy: nice. one more etiquette q: when is @channel acceptable vs @here vs user groups? timezone-aware rule?

DesignLead: Our rule: @channel = reserved for wide announcements (all-hands, product launches). @here = ok for quick asks during local working hours, use sparingly. User groups (e.g., @infra) only if you've checked with the group owner. If uncertain, DM the lead or ask in thread.

Jae: extra tips: 1) always use threads for follow-ups in high-traffic channels, 2) reactions for ACKs instead of "thanks", 3) prefix longer posts with [Help]/[FYI]/[Decision] so they show up in search.

Ivy: got it. where do I post my intro? #introductions or team channel?

Morgan: post a short intro in #introductions (name, role, timezone, one fun thing). Then drop a 1-line in your team channel saying what you'll tackle this week so folks know who to ping.

Ivy: will do. thanks for the fast help :smile:
